title: vv cross-scope lint rule registry (P0 seam)
description: Rule NAMES + when + owner + mode + inputs. P0 freezes the names/contracts; P1/P3/P4 implement them. Source: hive-research/vv-cross-scope-impact-rd.md §4.6, §14.5 (round-6), §20. Existing rule vocabulary (identity/status/dependency/completeness/approval/receipt/risk) is unchanged; these are the new cross-scope rules.
x-status: P0 frozen names — not yet implemented

prerequisites.generationGap: P1: extend structural rules to unique-tag artifacts (C-*/T-NNN/wave-N/child <status>) or make new rules generation-neutral. Currently structural rules apply only to legacy attribute-based artifacts (lint.ts:153-164).
prerequisites.cdataParser: P1 (NOT P0 schema): CDATA-aware tokenization in parseXmlLite. The shipped tokenizer has no CDATA handling; '<' inside snippet payloads (TS generics/JSX) throws on real plans. Plan-derived rules MUST be skipped with a reported warning on parse failure, never silently passed.

rules.name: impact-present
rules.description: Spec whose structured <paths> (P-NNN) touch a shared surface (db/schemas/, contracts/, migrations) must have <impact>. Path-triggered from a declared schema field, NOT tier (0/107 specs persist tier) and NOT raw prose.

rules.name: untouched-contradicted
rules.description: A host-census HARD edge (runtime-import/type-import/schema-barrel/contract-barrel) into a scope declared verified-untouched → error. Host computes edges; lint compares disposition against host output.

rules.name: census-impact-coverage
rules.description: Every consumer scope the host census returns with >=1 hard edge MUST appear as S-<SCOPE> with disposition cover-in-plan or defer-to-program. NO exclusion bypass v1. Closes the omission bypass.

rules.name: census-stale
rules.description: Claimed fan-out/output-digest ≠ host re-computation at the pinned ref → error. HOST recomputes and passes the digest into SpecLintOptions; lint compares only (purity invariant). Analogous to §K stale-approval.

rules.name: census-ref-unreachable
rules.description: Pinned ref absent (shallow clone / GC) → error.

rules.name: census-path-unresolvable
rules.description: A declared delete/rename from-path fails module resolution at baselineRef → error (not silent zero edges / false no-consumers).

rules.name: cross-scope-fanout
rules.description: Fan-out ≥ threshold. WARN until archive calibration (recorded operator acknowledgment), then ERROR (program forced, no override grant). High-precision untouched-contradicted goes error early; lower-precision fan-out stays warn until calibrated. Surfaced as risk: warn|mandatory (cross_scope_cascade: <N> scopes). Provisional threshold ≥3 distinct production consumer scopes with hard edges.

rules.name: census-incomplete
rules.description: A path/symbol in the plan's structured <deletes>/<renames> is absent from the SPEC-pinned census set → error. Compares two distinct artifacts (plan set vs spec set), not a set against a request derived from itself. Needs the plan, so runs at plan lint, NOT spec lint.

rules.name: cascade-concentration
rules.description: A single task deleting/renaming ≥N shared contracts or rewiring ≥M consumer read models → error requiring split or program. N/M calibrated in the P1 archive pass.

rules.name: consumer-coverage
rules.description: Every consumer scope in spec <impact> maps to ≥1 plan task <scope> or an explicit deferral with a valid target node ref.

rules.name: program-dag
rules.description: Program package DAG acyclic; every component owned exactly once; every package spec links back; every deferral node ref resolves to a P node (no range strings).

rules.name: stale-impact
rules.description: New consumer EDGE tuples (scope,kind,source,target) at currentRef vs the pinned baseline → drift gate (repo moved approve→execute). Edge-level, not scope-set (a new consumer inside an existing scope is drift). Current-side tolerates declared paths already moved/vanished (reported as removedDeclaredPaths drift). Empty destructive surface refused (stale-impact-vacuous-surface). baselineRef = approvals.json baseline_oid.

rules.name: stale-impact-vacuous-surface
rules.description: stale-impact called with an empty deletion+rename surface → typed refusal instead of a green. Derive the surface from the spec impact pin + plan deletes/renames.

rules.name: undeclared-deletion
rules.description: git diff (default WORKTREE: staged+unstaged vs baseline) shows a destructive entry absent from the plan surface → error. Kind-separated: D/T must match a declared delete; R must match a declared rename PAIR (from AND to) — a declared delete is not satisfied by a rename. Diff base = approvals.json baseline_oid. Symbol-level deletion is covered by census/plan lint, not this file-level gate.

rules.name: unresolved-addendum
rules.description: Any ADD-NNN whose status is not terminal (resolved/resolved-deferred/resolved-spawned) blocks execution. Host reads impact-addendum.xml in package mode; an addendum recorded by a dead executor must not rot silently.

notRules.name: work-item reference check
notRules.description: NOT a lint rule. A spec-time interview step checking which work-items reference the surfaces being deleted (§5 row).

notInP0.note: P0 = schemas + rule names + census contract only. Execute-specific vocabulary is not a spec/plan seam.
